policy.purpose: Secondary discovery sweep for local public events that may be announced outside the primary calendar feeds, including flyers, news posts, department notices, PTO/parent-group posts, and special-event pages.
rules: Primary live calendars continue to be checked on the normal refresh cadence; this monthly sweep is a backstop, not a replacement.
Search each source independently so a quiet department or school cannot disappear inside a generic district search.
Prefer the department, school, district, PTO/parent group, or organizer as confirmation before publication.
Include only public/community-relevant events; ordinary internal meetings, practices, and private activities are not promoted to What's Happening.
Cross-post family-oriented discoveries into the Family & Kids calendar when appropriate.
